title: JudgeRLVR: Judge First, Generate Second for Efficient Reasoning
reasoning: The paper introduces a new training paradigm (JudgeRLVR) for Large Language Models to improve reasoning efficiency and accuracy in mathematical and logical tasks. It does not discuss or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The mention of 'class balancing' refers to technical data sampling to avoid statistical bias, not ethical or social biases in LLMs.
